{"script":"rm -rf temp_workspace_check && mkdir -p temp_workspace_check
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace_check/recursive_listing.txt || true
awk -F'/' 'NF>0 && $NF=="workspace" {print $0}' temp_workspace_check/recursive_listing.txt > temp_workspace_check/candidate_paths.txt
: > temp_workspace_check/candidate_metadata.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  cp=$(readlink -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  type=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "missing")
  mode=$(stat -c '%a' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
  size=$(stat -c '%s' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
  mtime=$(stat -c '%Y' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
  inode=$(stat -c '%i' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
  printf '%s	%s	%s	%s	%s	%s	%s
' "$p" "$cp" "$type" "$mode" "$size" "$mtime" "$inode"
done < temp_workspace_check/candidate_paths.txt > temp_workspace_check/candidate_metadata.txt
awk -F'\t' '$3=="regular file" {print}' temp_workspace_check/candidate_metadata.txt > temp_workspace_check/regular_candidates.txt
cut -f2 temp_workspace_check/regular_candidates.txt | sed '/^$/d' | xargs -I{} readlink -f {} 2>/dev/null | sort -u > temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt
wc -l < temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt | tr -d ' ' > temp_workspace_check/regular_count.txt
: > temp_workspace_check/consistency_report.txt
while IFS= read -r cp; do
  [ -z "$cp" ] && continue
  case "$cp" in
    /working/*) under=1;;
    *) under=0;;
  esac
  rec_types=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cp" '$2==c{print $3}' temp_workspace_check/candidate_metadata.txt | sort -u | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')
  curr_type=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$cp" 2>/dev/null || echo "missing")
  if [ "$under" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "NOT_UNDER_WORKING: $cp" >> temp_workspace_check/consistency_report.txt
  fi
  if [ "$curr_type" != "$rec_types" ]; then
    echo "TYPE_MISMATCH: $cp current=$curr_type recorded=$rec_types" >> temp_workspace_check/consistency_report.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt
# Archive intermediate artifacts
tar -C temp_workspace_check -cf workspace_check_archive.tar recursive_listing.txt candidate_paths.txt candidate_metadata.txt regular_candidates.txt regular_unique.txt regular_count.txt consistency_report.txt 2>/dev/null || true
# Remove transient files but keep canonical files and reports and archive
rm -f temp_workspace_check/recursive_listing.txt temp_workspace_check/candidate_paths.txt temp_workspace_check/candidate_metadata.txt temp_workspace_check/regular_candidates.txt
# Create final_prep.txt
{
  echo "Canonical regular paths:"
  [ -s temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt ] && sed 's/^/ - /' temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt || echo " - (none)"
  echo ""
  echo "Verified count:"
  cat temp_workspace_check/regular_count.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "0"
  echo ""
  echo "Archive:"
  echo " temp_workspace_check/workspace_check_archive.tar"
  echo ""
  echo "Consistency report:"
  echo " temp_workspace_check/consistency_report.txt"
} > temp_workspace_check/final_prep.txt
# Final answer
cnt=$(cat temp_workspace_check/regular_count.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "$cnt" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi"}
